chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, used to dislike black except in three things: the turban, the khuff, and the cloak.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يَكْرَهُ: he disliked or regarded as disliked

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم dislike wearing black clothing?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله disliked the color black in clothing, while making exceptions for three items: the turban, the khuff, and the cloak. It is used in discussions of the etiquette and legal rulings of dress, including what is worn in salat (prayer).
